In C major, the chords built on each degree: I (C major), ii (D minor), iii (E minor), IV (F major), V (G major), vi (A minor), vii° (B diminished). So the third major chord would be the chord built on the third degree: E minor. But they ask "third major chord". Actually "major chord" might refer to the chord quality. In C major, the major chords are I (C major), IV (F major), and V (G major). The third major chord among them would be G major.
